report_topic: Public Health Infrastructure and Management of Health Services in Maharashtra
observations_summary: The audit found significant manpower shortages across all healthcare levels, with many construction and upgradation projects incomplete or unstarted, and a Super Speciality Hospital unutilised for over three years. It also highlighted procurement failures leading to unutilised funds and non-supply of essential items, non-compliance with safety and regulatory norms, and underutilisation of funds in various national health missions.
